###forward + backward predictor selection based on AIC 
```{r}
#initialize variables
selected_predictors <- c()
current_model <- base_model
current_aic <- AIC(base_model)
converged <- FALSE

#stepwise selection loop
while (!converged) {
  converged <- TRUE
  
  # Forward selection
  for (predictor in setdiff(predictor_list, selected_predictors)) {
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("cbind(n_kelp_gravel, n_gravel - n_kelp_gravel) ~ treatment*gravel_size +", 
            paste(c(selected_predictors, predictor), collapse = " + "), 
            "+ (1 | site) + (1 | month)")
    )
    new_model <- glmmTMB(formula, family = binomial, data = data)
    new_aic <- AIC(new_model)
    
    if (new_aic < current_aic) {
      current_model <- new_model
      current_aic <- new_aic
      selected_predictors <- c(selected_predictors, predictor)
      converged <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  # Backward elimination
  for (predictor in selected_predictors) {
    remaining_predictors <- setdiff(selected_predictors, predictor)
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("cbind(n_kelp_gravel, n_gravel - n_kelp_gravel) ~ treatment*gravel_size +", 
            paste(remaining_predictors, collapse = " + "), 
            "+ (1 | site) + (1 | month)")
    )
    new_model <- glmmTMB(formula, family = binomial, data = data)
    new_aic <- AIC(new_model)
    
    if (new_aic < current_aic) {
      current_model <- new_model
      current_aic <- new_aic
      selected_predictors <- remaining_predictors
      converged <- FALSE
    }
  }
}

#print results
print(selected_predictors)

summary(current_model)

exp(cbind(OR = fixef(current_model)$cond, confint(current_model, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")))
```

#Growth - June
```{r}
growth_data <- data[!is.na(data$kelp_growth)  & data$month == "June",]   #do for each month - April May June

base_model <- glmmTMB(kelp_growth ~ treatment*gravel_size + (1 | site),
                      family = Gamma(link="log"), 
                      data = growth_data)

# Initialize variables
selected_predictors <- c()
current_model <- base_model
current_aic <- AIC(base_model)
converged <- FALSE

# Stepwise selection loop
while (!converged) {
  converged <- TRUE
  
  # Forward selection
  for (predictor in setdiff(predictor_list, selected_predictors)) {
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("kelp_growth ~ treatment*gravel_size +", 
            paste(c(selected_predictors, predictor), collapse = " + "), 
            "+ (1 | site)")
    )
    new_model <- tryCatch(
  glmmTMB(formula,
          family = Gamma(link="log"),
          data = growth_data),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (is.null(new_model)) next

new_aic <- AIC(new_model)

if (is.na(new_aic)) next

if (new_aic < current_aic) {
      current_model <- new_model
      current_aic <- new_aic
      selected_predictors <- c(selected_predictors, predictor)
      converged <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  # Backward elimination
  for (predictor in selected_predictors) {
    remaining_predictors <- setdiff(selected_predictors, predictor)
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("kelp_growth ~ treatment*gravel_size +", 
            paste(c(selected_predictors, predictor), collapse = " + "), 
            "+ (1 | site) ")
    )
    new_model <- glmmTMB(formula, family = Gamma(link="log"), data = growth_data)
    new_aic <- AIC(new_model)
    
    if (new_aic < current_aic) {
      current_model <- new_model
      current_aic <- new_aic
      selected_predictors <- remaining_predictors
      converged <- FALSE
    }
  }
}

# Print results
print(selected_predictors)
summary(current_model)

june_model <- current_model

#Check colinearity 
#lm_model <- lm(kelp_growth ~ treatment + ts_density + mean_light_lux + urchin_site_density + urchin_density, data = growth_data)
lm_model <- lm(kelp_growth ~ treatment*gravel_size + ts_density + ts_density + mean_light_lux + urchin_site_density + urchin_density + treatment*urchin_site_density + treatment*ts_site_density, data = growth_data)

vif(lm_model, type="predictor") 

vif(lm_model) 

#Visualize 
#simple model

testDispersion(fittedModel) #check for overdispersion
``` 
